# Sattaya Singkul (สัตยา สิงห์กุล)

> Specialist Lead, AI Solution Engineer at True Digital Group, Bangkok, Thailand. AI engineer building voice assistants, LLM agents and speech systems that ship to production.

AI engineer with 6+ years of experience building production-grade AI products with LLMs, NLP, voice, multi-agent and on-premise AI systems. I design and deploy end-to-end systems that serve large user bases — conversational AI, voice assistants and intelligent automation — and turn research into products with measurable user and business impact.

## Experience
### Specialist (Lead), AI Solution & Platform — True Digital Group (full-time; May 2025 – Present)
Technical AI lead for production voice and LLM systems on the TrueX platform.
- Built and deployed a production AI voice assistant on a multi-agent architecture, serving 800K MAU and 2M+ downloads on TrueX.
- Own end-to-end design of AI systems for large-scale users, from architecture to production rollout.
- Designed LLM systems with RAG, memory and tool orchestration (MCP) for real-world interaction and IoT control.
- Lead architecture integrating ASR, TTS, LLM reasoning, on-premise AI and real-time interaction pipelines.
- Established evaluation frameworks for LLM systems covering performance, robustness and reliability.
- Partner with product on AI features; mentor engineers and set technical direction for multi-agent work.
- Author of 6 patents on RAG and AI agent systems (in the publishing process).

### AI Research Engineer (advanced level) — KASIKORN Business-Technology Group (KBTG) (full-time; Feb 2022 – Apr 2025)
Research-to-production NLP, speech and LLM systems for banking.
- Step: Research Engineer B2 — Human-Computer Interaction Expert (Apr 2024 – Apr 2025)
- Step: Research Engineer B1 — Voice Specialist (Feb 2022 – Apr 2024)
- Built conversational AI that automates 80% of KBank's customer chat traffic, saving 300,000 customer hours.
- Designed an LLM-based search and reasoning system covering 93% of call-center use cases.
- Developed sentiment analysis, ASR, TTS and knowledge-retrieval pipelines across support, analytics and automation.
- Presented AI solutions to technical, non-technical and executive audiences.
- Presented 4 research papers at ACM, IEEE and Springer venues.

### Research Assistant (NCR) — National Electronics and Computer Technology Center (NECTEC) (full-time; Jun 2020 – Dec 2020 · Jul 2021 – Dec 2021)
Thai speech and NLP research in the Speech and Text Understanding lab.
- Researched Thai speaker verification and diarization robust to noisy, reverberant audio (Kaldi, PyTorch).
- Deployed Thai speaker-verification models to the 'AI for Thai' API platform.

### Research Scientist — Synthesia (contract; Oct 2023 – Jul 2024)
Research on AI-driven video synthesis and multimodal systems with international teams.

### Product Owner — Thailand Mental Health Tech Discovery, Mahidol University (contract; Mar 2021 – Dec 2024)
Led a team of 7 building AI health-tech that combines psychology and machine learning.
- Delivered ~11 AI projects, including 'AI Care Avatar' and the 'Psyjai Dashboard'.
- Built and tuned emotion-recognition models for health-tech products.

### Data Scientist — Siam Commercial Bank (SCB) (contract; Jan 2020 – Jul 2020 · Jun 2021 – Nov 2021)
Speech emotion recognition for call-center applications.

### Speech/Audio AI Intern — Dolby Laboratories (internship; Jan 2021 – Jun 2021)
Deep learning models for speech and audio processing in an international R&D team (Dolby U).

### Research Assistant — Faculty of IT, KMITL — PRIP Lab (contract; Aug 2019 – Jan 2025)
Computational linguistics and pattern-recognition research.

### Research Engineer (intern) — KBTG — Super AI Engineer program (internship; Mar 2021 – May 2021)
Deployed a QA search-engine service with Elasticsearch, PyTorch and TensorFlow.

### Data Scientist (intern) — KBTG — Machine Learning Bootcamp (internship; Jun 2019 – Aug 2019)
Thai dependency parsing with EDU segmentation for 'AI for Thai'. Best Progress & Popular Vote awards.

### Data Research Analyst — Wisesight (internship; Jun 2018 – Mar 2019)
Social-listening analytics with ZocialEye, Python and Tableau.

### Digital Business Development Trainee — Village Farm Winery (internship; Jan 2018 – Jun 2018)
Digitised paper records into a cloud ERP with Python and OCR; customer segmentation.

## Selected AI products
- Voice AI Assistant (TrueX · True Digital Group): 800K monthly active users. Multi-agent LLM with voice interaction for IoT control. Real-time interaction with memory and tool integration (MCP). 2M+ downloads on the TrueX platform.
- PII Call-Center Blinding (Security compliance zone · 6 sites, Thailand): 2,300 call-hours per day on one RTX Pro 6000. Speaker-attributed transcription with PII masking for insurance call-center scripts. Large-model batch optimisation sized to run on a single GPU.
- Chatbot Automation (KBank · KBTG): 80% of customer chat traffic automated. Saved 300,000 customer hours.
- Call-Center AI System (KBank · KBTG): 93% of call-center use cases covered. LLM-based search and reasoning for agents.

## Open source
- FinOps-Estimator: Capacity planning and FinOps estimation for conversational-AI pipelines: VRAM, latency budgets and GPU cost for STT, LLM, TTS and RAG workloads. https://github.com/JoesSattes/FinOps-Estimator
- Thai-TTS-Evaluation: Evaluation scripts for Thai text-to-speech, focused on speaker tone and pronunciation. https://github.com/JoesSattes/Thai-TTS-Evaluation
- Self-Supervised-LTMMv2: LTMMv2 — notes on a self-supervised Thai speech foundation model. https://github.com/JoesSattes/Self-Supervised-LTMMv2
- CHiME4-SER-Conv-TasNet-Speech-Enhancement: Conv-TasNet speech enhancement on CHiME-4 with ESPnet, used ahead of speech emotion recognition. https://github.com/JoesSattes/CHiME4-SER-Conv-TasNet-Speech-Enhancement
- Vector-Database-Practice-Courses: Coursework notebooks on vector databases and semantic search. https://github.com/JoesSattes/Vector-Database-Practice-Courses
- Thai-Biaffine-Dependency-Parsing: Biaffine dependency parser for Thai on Universal Dependencies treebanks. https://github.com/JoesSattes/Thai-Biaffine-Dependency-Parsing
